title: tephroseris subscaposa
intro: Tephroseris subscaposa, commonly known as the alpine marigold or alpine daisy, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family, native to high-altitude regions of the Himalayas. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Tephroseris subscaposa include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
